outputs.explanation: Panel A is a sequence conservation logo, not a plot of averaged data; check not applicable.
Scatter plot of inhibition zone (%) shows mean ± SEM with individual gray dots overlaid for each replicate, as stated in the caption.
Panel C consists of epifluorescence micrographs, not an averaged-data plot.
Fluorescence intensity plot shows mean ± SEM with individual yellow open-circle data points for each cell overlaid.
Fluorescence intensity plot shows mean ± SEM with individual blue open-circle data points for each cell overlaid.
Panel F shows PALM super-resolution microscopy images of individual cells, not an averaged-data plot.
Number of clusters/cell plot shows mean ± SEM with individual gray open-circle data points for each cell overlaid.
Cluster size plot (log scale) shows mean ± SEM with individual gray dots for each cluster overlaid.
Mol.% into clusters plot shows mean ± SEM with individual gray open-circle data points for each cell overlaid.
